document.about: Acta Crystallographica Section E (2018) research communication, '(2R,3R)-1,4-Dioxaspiro[4.4]nonane-2,3-dicarboxylic and (2R,3R)-1,4-dioxaspiro[4.5]decane-2,3-dicarboxylic acids', PMC6073000. Its tables give lengths in ångströms, the `Å` drawn as an `A` and a spacing ring set over it on a pen line of its own, raised above the text's baseline; a cited author's name is drawn the same way, letters and spacing carons and acutes. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.
